Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited, but we hit a snag on our side. Procurement needs an approved SOW and an internal security checklist signed before we can move sandbox capacity to production. That will add roughly 3 weeks to our timeline.

Given the delay (and our need to show results to the board before the end of September), can Redwood provide a one-time extension on the sandbox/POC window and a modest top-up of credits so we can complete the integration and an end-to-end run before procurement closes? Specifically: 30 additional compute credits and an extra 30 days on the sandbox.

I realize that’s outside the standard PLG limits, but this is the inflection point for our evaluation. Happy to get on a quick call if it helps.

Thanks,
Liam

My initial take: we can approve a one-off 30-day extension on the sandbox internally (no revenue impact) and offer either 20 compute credits now with a further 10 contingent on a signed reserved commitment within 45 days, or 30 credits upfront for an exec-approved exception.
